usedFor: Google Forms collects answers, and Instantly gets each respondent as a lead through “Create Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Response” in Google Forms, then “Add Lead to Campaign” in Instantly
bestTemplate.why: A response becomes a lead already placed in a campaign, so outreach starts from the form.

watchOut: “New Form Response” is polling, so a new lead appears after the next scheduled check.
